{
  "target_verification": {
    "building_identity": "high",
    "floor_identity": "high",
    "visual_relevance": "high",
    "verdict": "exact_match",
    "reason": "All cited sources consistently identify the subject as Tiananmen Gate (not a palace, temple, or generic 'gate'), confirm its two-tiered structure (lower city platform + upper pavilion), and provide architectural specifics matching user’s focus: multi-layered roof (double-eaved hip-and-gable/歇山顶), eaves curvature, dougong bracket sets, marble-based platform (xumizuo), balustrades (white marble railings with lotus-bottle motifs), latticed windows (36 diamond-patterned shutters), and glazed tile roofing (yellow glazed tiles). No conflicting building identity or floor count found."
  },
  "generation_module": "exterior_architecture",
  "scene_goal": "Generate a photorealistic exterior architectural visualization of Tiananmen Gate that accurately conveys its canonical volumetric hierarchy, structural articulation, and material richness — prioritizing correct roof form, eave profile, dougong rhythm, platform proportion, railing detail, window lattice pattern, and tile texture — without requiring interior spatial fidelity.",
  "spaces": [
    {
      "name": "city platform",
      "type": "exterior",
      "confidence": "confirmed"
    },
    {
      "name": "pavilion superstructure",
      "type": "exterior",
      "confidence": "confirmed"
    }
  ],
  "space_contracts": [
    {
      "space": "city platform",
      "boundary_mode": "closed",
      "floor": true,
      "walls": ["red-painted masonry wall", "glazed tile coping"],
      "ceiling": false,
      "openings": ["five arched gateways", "two horse-ramps (ma dao)"],
      "connections": ["pavilion superstructure (directly above)", "ground level (via ramps)"],
      "vertical_geometry": ["1.59m high white marble xumizuo base", "13m high red brick core", "glazed tile-capped parapet"],
      "content_after_envelope": ["stone lions (east/west)", "golden characters on plaque"]
    },
    {
      "space": "pavilion superstructure",
      "boundary_mode": "semi_open",
      "floor": true,
      "walls": ["red-painted wooden columns", "lacquered panel walls", "dougong-bearing eave soffits"],
      "ceiling": true,
      "openings": ["36 diamond-lattice windows (front/back)", "colonnaded peristyle (all four sides)"],
      "connections": ["city platform (base support)", "roof structure (above)"],
      "vertical_geometry": ["two-tiered eave system", "raised central bay", "projecting corner eaves"],
      "content_after_envelope": ["17 large red lanterns (1 main + 16 auxiliary)", "national emblem (centered on front eave)"]
    }
  ],
  "envelope_model": "assembled_elements_with_verified_joints",
  "hard_finish": {
    "required": ["floor_finish", "wall_finish", "ceiling_finish", "door_window_frame_finish", "threshold_or_sill", "readable_room_light"],
    "conditional": ["hvac_grille", "detector_or_sprinkler"],
    "exclude_by_default": ["furniture", "decorative_props", "unverified_equipment"]
  },
  "adjacency_graph": [
    {
      "from": "city platform",
      "to": "pavilion superstructure",
      "connection": "structural_support",
      "confidence": "confirmed"
    }
  ],
  "relationships": [
    "The pavilion superstructure sits centered atop the city platform, aligned with Beijing’s central axis.",
    "The double-eaved roof visually dominates the composition, with pronounced upward curvature at corners and layered eave projection emphasizing vertical hierarchy.",
    "Dougong clusters are rhythmically spaced beneath all eaves — denser at corners and central bays — supporting both structural load and ornamental emphasis.",
    "White marble balustrades crown both platform edges and pavilion colonnade, featuring carved lotus-and-vase (lianhebao) panels.",
    "Yellow glazed roof tiles are laid in precise courses with ridge-end dragon吻 (chiwen) and eight ridge-end beasts (zou shou) on each垂脊."
  ],
  "spatial_envelope": {
    "mode": "semi_open",
    "footprint": "rectangular (approx. 61.6m × 37m)",
    "boundary_segments": ["floor", "wall", "roof"],
    "openings": ["archway", "window", "stair_void"],
    "vertical_connections": ["column-to-platform junction", "eave-to-roof transition"]
  },
  "visual_language": {
    "style": "Chinese imperial architecture (Ming-Qing dynasty, official style)",
    "materials": ["yellow glazed ceramic roof tiles", "vermilion lacquered wood", "white marble (xumizuo and railings)", "gold-leafed dougong and beam ends", "black lacquer window frames"],
    "lighting": "midday natural light with strong directional sun to emphasize eave shadows and tile sheen",
    "mood": "solemn, monumental, ceremonial, historically grounded"
  },
  "must_have": [
    "Double-eaved hip-and-gable (xiēshān) roof with concave curvature and upturned corners",
    "Nine-ridge configuration (1 main ridge + 4垂脊 + 4戗脊) with chiwen and zoushou",
    "Three-tiered dougong assemblies under primary eaves, visible and structurally legible",
    "White marble xumizuo base (1.59m high) with carved lotus motifs",
    "36 diamond-lattice (linghua) windows — 18 per front/back facade — with black lacquer frames",
    "Red-painted masonry platform with glazed tile capping and balustrade",
    "Symmetrical five-arch gateway beneath platform"
  ],
  "quality_gates": [
    "Roof geometry must match ‘nine-ridge’ terminology and visual proportions from historical references.",
    "Dougong must be modeled as discrete, interlocking wooden components — not simplified textures.",
    "All yellow roof tiles must exhibit subtle variation in glaze reflectivity and edge wear consistent with age and exposure.",
    "Balustrade panels must show accurate lotus-and-vase carving depth and spacing.",
    "No interior room layout or furniture modeling — only exterior envelope and attached elements (lanterns, emblem, plaques)."
  ],
  "delivery_views": [
    "Front elevation (full height, centered, orthographic)",
    "Southeast 3/4 perspective (showing corner eave uplift and dougong layering)",
    "Detail close-up of front eave: dougong + lintel + window lattice + column base"
  ],
  "prompt_directives": [
    "Use photorealistic PBR materials — no stylization or cartoon rendering.",
    "Prioritize architectural legibility over atmospheric effects (e.g., avoid heavy fog or dramatic clouds unless specified).",
    "All dimensions derived from verified sources only; do not extrapolate unconfirmed measurements.",
    "Model lanterns as attached external fixtures — not part of structural envelope.",
    "Exclude modern signage, scaffolding, or non-historical elements."
  ],
  "hard_constraints": [
    "No deviation from double-eaved xiēshān roof typology.",
    "Must include five arched gateways — central one largest — beneath platform.",
    "Must use yellow glazed tile for roof; no alternate colors or materials.",
    "Must place national emblem centered on front lower eave — diameter ~1.7m.",
    "No interior volume modeling beyond what defines exterior envelope (e.g., ceiling plane is required; interior columns are not)."
  ],
  "soft_constraints": [
    "Eave curvature should follow documented concave profile for rain runoff and solar gain optimization.",
    "Lanterns may be simplified to geometric forms if full mechanical detail impedes render performance.",
    "Marble texture may use procedural noise if high-res scans unavailable — but grain direction and polish level must match reference photos."
  ],
  "uncertainties": [
    "Exact number and arrangement of zoushou (walking beasts) on each垂脊 — sources vary between 8–10; default to 8 per垂脊 as most consistently cited.",
    "Precise chamfer angle and section profile of dougong arms — no engineering drawings available; rely on high-res photo references.",
    "Subtle color variation in vermillion paint across surfaces (sun-fading vs. sheltered zones) — treat as artistic interpretation within historical palette."
  ],
  "sources": [
    {
      "title": "详解天安门城楼的建筑特色",
      "url": "http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/dfpd/bj/2009-09/22/content_8720224.htm",
      "channel": "agent_reach_exa",
      "reason": "Confirms double-eaved xiēshān roof, dougong placement, latticed windows, and golden dragon motifs — key exterior features."
    },
    {
      "title": "承天之门——天安门城楼 - 重建后的承天门城楼 - 《城楼古景》",
      "url": "http://szzy.7lue.cn/read/6c51bf74fca46ecf386c958ad533144d/Text-chapter6.xhtml",
      "channel": "agent_reach_exa",
      "reason": "Provides roof geometry description (concave curve, nine ridges), platform height (33.7m pre-1970), and stylistic intent."
    },
    {
      "title": "地标建筑 天安门 - 建筑之窗",
      "url": "https://www.jianzhuzhichuang.com/cms/dibiaojianzhu/3609.html",
      "channel": "agent_reach_exa",
      "reason": "Verifies dimensions (66m × 37m), nine-bay façade, five-arch base, and material specification (yellow glazed tile, red lacquer, white marble)."
    },
    {
      "title": "天安门",
      "url": "https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A9%E5%AE%89%E9%97%A8",
      "channel": "agent_reach_exa",
      "reason": "Confirms xumizuo height (1.59m), platform area, lantern specs, and colonnade depth (~3m) — critical for exterior proportioning."
    }
  ]
}
